messages:
maya: Heads up — doing an a11y pass on Batch Vectors preview. Found a few confusing bits around row actions + export copy. Threading examples so we can triage.

cheng: Can you paste the exact flow/screens where this is happening?

maya: Steps: open Batch > Preview > hover a row > click the kebab menu (...) > actions show: 'Download', 'Copy id', 'Remove'. Problems: 1) screen readers announce terse labels ('Button Download', 'Button Copy id') which is ambiguous; 2) export CTA at top says 'Download vectors' but export supports CSV and JSONL — no format hint; 3) keyboard focus order jumps from the row checkbox into the kebab button (should be content first then actions for SR).

liam: Agreed on labels. Proposal: change menu items to longer aria-labels: 'Download vector as CSV', 'Copy vector id to clipboard', 'Remove vector (destructive)'. And change top CTA to 'Export vectors (CSV, JSONL)'.

alex: Also: add a sr-only live region announcing export progress. e.g., `aria-live="polite"` messages: 'Export started for 12 items', 'Export complete: 12 rows, link ready'. Don't auto-open file dialog for SR users.

sam: Quick UX Qs: 1) Default format? 2) Should 'Remove' be inline or in a confirm modal? I think modal.

maya: Default = CSV, but explicit radio in export modal is best. 'Remove' must be destructive and behind a confirmation modal + keyboard-confirmable. Also need roving tabindex in menu so arrow keys navigate menu items and Esc closes.

a11y-bot: a11y-checker: batch-preview v0.9 audit -> FAIL (3 items): menu-labels missing verbosity; export live-region absent; focus-order inconsistency. Ticket created: INF-4821.

cheng: I'll open a PR to update copy + aria attributes. Will include markup snippets and examples for screen readers.

liam: For acceptance criteria (AC):
- AC1: Top CTA reads exactly 'Export vectors (CSV, JSONL)'.
- AC2: Kebab menu items have aria-labels that include object and action (e.g., 'Copy vector id to clipboard').
- AC3: Export start/completion posted to polite live region with counts; completion includes a link element announced to SRs.
- AC4: Keyboard navigation: row checkbox -> row content -> kebab menu; within menu arrow keys navigate, Enter activates; focus restored after close.
- AC5: 'Remove' opens confirm modal, keyboard-confirmable, warns destructively.

alex: :thumbsup: I'll add cypress + axe checks for these. I'll also add a test for the sr-live region announcements.

maya: Thanks team. Cheng/sam — ping me on the PR, I'll do a quick a11y copy pass and check VoiceOver.

sam: Will do. I'll stub the modal copy and radio defaults in figma and drop links here when ready.

maya: Minor copy suggestion for export modal: header = 'Export vectors', primary = 'Export (CSV)', secondary = 'Export (JSONL)'. Include small helper text: 'Exports include vector id, embedding values truncated at 8 decimals by default.'

cheng: Noted. Adding helper text + aria-describedby pointing at helper node.

liam: One more nit — in the preview table, the row title truncation should expose full text on focus, not hover, for keyboard/SR users. Add visually-hidden tooltip that becomes visible on focus.

maya: Good call. That should resolve a couple of reported bugs from Support.

a11y-bot: a11y-checker: re-run queued after PR merge -> will post results here.
